caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object that resembles a band or bracelet, shown at an angle against a plain light background. The object is predominantly gray and appears to be made from a hard material, possibly metal. The band is oval-shaped, relatively thick, and smoothly textured, except for one segment which extends upward into a flat, rounded, raised plaque-like section. This raised section has a geometric, engraved design composed of triangular and rectangular shapes divided by etched lines. There is a small, circular hole near the top center of the plaque. The shading of the drawing is done in grays and blacks, giving the object depth and emphasizing its three-dimensional form. The artist's name "LIPKIN" is printed in small letters below the object on the left side.
title: Pa. German Hound's Band from Conestoga Wagon
